source_priority.theme: Late-cycle expansion (narrow, capex-led, sticky inflation) behavioral scenario validation
source_priority.rationale: Late-cycle expansion (narrow, capex-led, sticky inflation) is a primary scenario in the active behavioral macro source with ensemble probability 84.2%. The seed exists to validate whether bottom-up evidence and market behavior confirm the same behavioral path.
source_priority.edge_hypothesis: The market may be under- or over-pricing the transition into Late-cycle expansion (narrow, capex-led, sticky inflation). Research should test whether preferred exposures such as grid_power_infrastructure, quality_ai, electrical_equipment, engineering_construction offer cleaner risk/reward than vulnerable exposures such as small_caps, auto_parts_salvage, using behavioral scenario ids rather than the retired narrative taxonomy.
sub_questions: Which themes have direct positive exposure to Late-cycle expansion (narrow, capex-led, sticky inflation) without relying on stale narrative scenario ids?
Where are preferred exposures (grid_power_infrastructure, quality_ai, electrical_equipment, engineering_construction) showing bottom-up confirmation?
Which vulnerable exposures (small_caps, auto_parts_salvage) are beginning to break or de-rate?
Are confirming catalysts appearing: Hormuz reopening framework announced and tanker traffic normalizes?
What would invalidate this path: Oil rebounds above recent shock highs on renewed disruption?
Are confirming catalysts appearing: Renewed Hormuz disruption or attacks on shipping infrastructure?

supporting_evidence.claim: Behavioral seed priority derived from ensemble probability 84.2% and current_conditions designation 'primary'.
